purpose: Teach: 半月/高麗/理学部/無害/音痴/科学技術庁/初等/開発途上国

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、月の半月で業績評価を行え
lines.en: We conduct performance evaluations every half-month.
lines.style: Clipped, commanding cadence. Each phrase lands with intention. No softening. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard the first time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。高麗人参を含む健康食品事業を強化します
lines.en: Understood. We'll strengthen our health supplement division.
lines.style: Measured, formal acknowledgment. Calm intake of breath before responding. Steady pace — professional, not rushed. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、理学部卒の研究員を採用しろ
lines.en: Hire research staff with science degrees.
lines.style: Flat, economical. No emphasis — the instruction carries its own weight. Minimal breath. The voice of someone who expects execution, not discussion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品を無害な素材で作ります
lines.en: Understood. We'll develop products using safe, non-toxic materials.
lines.style: Formal confirmation. Slightly faster than before — showing he's already thinking ahead. Composed, methodical. The sound of someone taking detailed mental notes.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の音痴会議は避けろ、つまり調和のない会議を避けろ
lines.en: Avoid disharmonious meetings among staff. In other words, ensure alignment in every gathering.
lines.style: Measured, almost philosophical weight to the second phrase. Slight pause before the clarification, as if choosing words carefully. Serious but not harsh.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。旧科学技術庁関連の人脈を活用します
lines.en: Understood. We'll leverage our network from the former Science and Technology Agency.
lines.style: Confident, slightly faster. The ease of someone who knows exactly how to execute. Brief, assured. Professional pride in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、初等教育向け教材事業も検討しろ
lines.en: We should also explore the primary education materials market.
lines.style: Deliberate, expansive — opening a new direction. Slight lean forward in the delivery. Thoughtful pause after the opening. The voice of strategic vision being shared.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。開発途上国市場への進出を計画します
lines.en: Understood. We'll plan our entry into developing markets.
lines.style: Crisp final confirmation. Slightly more energy than previous responses — the close of a meeting, settling into action. Clear, professional finish.
